teams.detail: Enter the All-Star break at 48-49 after beating Tampa Bay 8-2 Sunday behind a Randy Arozarena three-run homer. The All-Star Game is Tuesday (8 PM ET, Citizens Bank Park); Seattle returns Friday to open a series vs. the Giants at T-Mobile Park.
Fell to the Knicks 86-75 in Summer League Monday despite 24 points from Chaz Lanier (8-for-13, 3-for-3 from three). Next: Wednesday 7/15, 6 PM ET vs. Suns (ESPNU).

The Paul Allen Estate's agreement to sell the franchise to a Khosla family-led group for a record $9.612B still needs ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 owners. Training camp opens July 25 in Renton; Football Fest is Aug. 8 at Lumen Field.

Landed a 4-star cornerback commitment, the class's highest-rated pledge, while still chasing a second corner and offensive line help. RB Jordan Washington is targeting a late-July return from his spring injury ahead of fall camp.

Added commitments from Croatian forward Boris Tišma and Australian guard Tristan Devers, plus new assistant coach DeAndre Haynes (ex-Marquette). F Hannes Steinbach (14th overall to Charlotte) remains the program's top NBA export as Danny Sprinkle rebuilds after losing Zoom Diallo to the portal.

headlines.headline: Kansas lands nation's No. 1 recruit as offseason roster overhaul accelerates across college hoops
headlines.detail: Kansas secured a commitment from the nation's top-ranked incoming prospect, while Kentucky added Iowa State transfer forward Milan Momcilovic and North Carolina replaced departed center Henri Veesaar with two international signees. More than 2,700 players have moved through the transfer portal since Michigan beat UConn for the national title.

headlines.headline: AJ Dybantsa headlines Summer League as LeBron James explores a landing spot after leaving the Lakers
headlines.detail: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa is averaging 25 points per game and has his Summer League team to 2-0 in Las Vegas, while No. 2 pick Darryn Peterson has scored 23-plus points in each of his four summer outings. LeBron James has informed the Lakers he won't return in 2026-27, with his camp reportedly eyeing the Knicks, 76ers, and Celtics.

headlines.headline: Seahawks' record $9.6B sale headlines a quiet NFL Monday focused on training-camp prep
headlines.detail: The Paul Allen Estate's agreement to sell the Seahawks to a Khosla family-led group for $9.612 billion — an NFL record — continued to dominate league business news, still needing ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 owners. The Packers extended linebacker Isaiah McDuffie as teams finalized rookie contracts ahead of training camps.

headlines.headline: Transfer portal QB market shifts as $10M Miami move and Oklahoma's Jason Witten hire reshape rosters
headlines.detail: Duke transfer quarterback Darian Mensah's reported $10 million move to Miami continues to reverberate through ACC title odds, while Oklahoma rebuilt its tight end room with three transfers and hired former NFL tight end Jason Witten as position coach. Rosters are locked in for fall camp with the portal window closed since January.
